meta.source: the Minhajna design canvas, shared stylesheet tb.css and 141 boards

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground of every phone screen and of the web app's main area. Text on it: ink (15.0:1), ink2 (7.3:1), pencil (5.4:1).

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, inputs, list rows and the book page. Text on it: ink (15.9:1), ink2 (7.8:1), pencil (5.7:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text by default, and everything the teacher confirmed (PRD §3.1 rule 3). Reads on every light ground here, at 11.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: ink2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles in bars, captions, labels, facts, legends. On paper, sheet, well, due, private, alt-day and pill-on (6.0:1 or more).

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: What the app proposes and the teacher has not confirmed yet, the pencil of PRD §3.1 rule 3: proposal text, rows awaiting confirmation, removed map nodes. On sheet 5.7:1, paper 5.4:1, alt-day 5.0:1. Always with a word or the dashed pencil-edge, never colour alone (PRD §6.8).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, list separators, the bottom bar's top edge, table rows. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Control borders at 1.5px (inputs, chips, outline buttons, segmented controls, steppers, roll-call toggles, map nodes), the sheet's grab handle and the switch's off track. Only 1.7:1 on sheet, below the 3:1 WCAG 2.2 asks for control boundaries: kept as drawn on the canvas, flagged under Accessibility.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The book page's ruled lines and column rules, and the rules of the absence grid. Decorative.

tokens.name: dots
tokens.usage: The dotted ruling under each line of the book page, as on the paper texts book. Decorative.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: The blackboard: primary buttons, selected chips and segments, the absent toggle, the confirmed tick, the welcome hero, the web sidebar and the app icon. Text and icons on it: chalk (12.8:1) or hi (10.2:1).

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: Text, icons and the logo on board.

tokens.name: hi
tokens.usage: Chalk yellow: the snackbar's action on board, the selected late toggle, the threshold chip on charts. Text on it: ink (11.5:1). An accent, never a judgement of a teacher (PRD §2.6).

tokens.name: ar
tokens.usage: The Arabic subject's colour: class chips and the book tab. Text on it: on-subject (8.6:1).

tokens.name: fr
tokens.usage: The French subject's colour: class chips and the book tab. Text on it: on-subject (5.1:1).

tokens.name: subject
tokens.usage: The current subject's colour. A screen sets it to ar, fr or en; it names the subject, never a status.

tokens.name: on-subject
tokens.usage: Text on a subject colour: the class chip and the book tab.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Soft buttons inside a card, such as Roll call, Count and View. Text: ink (12.9:1).

tokens.name: pill-on
tokens.usage: The selected tab's pill in the bottom navigation, and the default badge ground. Text: ink, ink2 (6.0:1).

tokens.name: alt-day
tokens.usage: Every other day on the book page and the homework page, as on paper; the selected roll-call row. Text: ink, pencil.

tokens.name: due
tokens.usage: The roll-call and homework strips in a session card, the totals row of the absence grid, a selected table row. Text: ink, ink2.

tokens.name: private
tokens.usage: The private-note panel and the rules box: what never leaves the phone (PRD §5.4). Text: ink, ink2.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: The ground of the done badge. Text: ok-ink (8.7:1).

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ok and on band-1.

tokens.name: book-edge
tokens.usage: The book page's outer border and header rule at 1.5px; the dashed border of held-back figures. 3.6:1 on sheet.

tokens.name: fr-edge
tokens.usage: The book page's border when the subject is French.

tokens.name: fr-head
tokens.usage: The book page's column headers when the subject is French (6.3:1 on sheet).

tokens.name: pencil-edge
tokens.usage: The dashed 1.5px border of a proposal and of the signature pad. 2.3:1 on sheet, so it is never the only sign: a proposal also carries its tag, such as «مقترح من المخطط».

tokens.name: late-edge
tokens.usage: The border of the selected late toggle and of the threshold card.

tokens.name: head-ink
tokens.usage: Column headers on the book page, the homework page and the month page, in Aref Ruqaa (9.7:1 on sheet).

tokens.name: signature
tokens.usage: The teacher's drawn signature, in blue ink, on sheet (11.1:1). Printouts and PDFs only (PRD §3.8).

tokens.name: sep-dot
tokens.usage: The 4px dot between parts of a session's meta line. Decorative.

tokens.name: page-ring
tokens.usage: The ring around a book page number.

tokens.name: page-ink
tokens.usage: The book page number.

tokens.name: link-row
tokens.usage: A tappable row in the absence grid.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: chalk-dust
tokens.usage: The dotted texture of the welcome hero, 1px dots every 7px.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Table headers, key-and-value boxes, notes and the 'no key' map node on web screens. Text: ink (14.6:1), ink2 (7.1:1).

tokens.name: chalk-82
tokens.usage: Links in the web sidebar, on board (9.1:1).

tokens.name: chalk-80
tokens.usage: Secondary text on board in national headers and on selected segments.

tokens.name: chalk-75
tokens.usage: Secondary text in the web sidebar, on board (7.9:1).

tokens.name: chalk-70
tokens.usage: The PIN dots on the lock screen.

tokens.name: chalk-40
tokens.usage: The border of a pill button on board.

tokens.name: chalk-35
tokens.usage: The border of an outline button in the web sidebar. 2.9:1 on board, just under 3:1.

tokens.name: chalk-22
tokens.usage: The keypad's key rings on the lock screen.

tokens.name: chalk-14
tokens.usage: The selected item in the web sidebar; its text is chalk (8.4:1).

tokens.name: notice
tokens.usage: A notice that needs a step before going on, such as a key not saved, a correction or a waiting step; always with a dashed notice-edge and words. Text: ink (15.2:1).

tokens.name: notice-edge
tokens.usage: The dashed 1.5px border of a notice and of a waiting step's dot.

tokens.name: notice-ink
tokens.usage: 'Pending' words and the warning badge's text, on notice-strong (6.9:1) or sheet (7.7:1).

tokens.name: notice-strong
tokens.usage: The warning badge's ground.

tokens.name: notice-line
tokens.usage: A warning outline on a map, dashed 3 3.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: A check that needs attention in a list of checks, on sheet (6.3:1).

tokens.name: threshold
tokens.usage: An exam threshold's line on charts: solid once published, dashed until then, always with its chip and its value in words (PRD §7.10). 3.9:1 on sheet.

tokens.name: threshold-card
tokens.usage: The threshold card on the director's dashboard, with a late-edge border. Text: ink.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: Hatching, with hatch-ground, for figures held back under the minimum group size (PRD §5.10); dotted reference lines on charts.

tokens.name: hatch-ground
tokens.usage: The ground of hatching, and the lowest totals band. Text: ink2.

tokens.name: band-1
tokens.usage: The middle totals band. Text: ok-ink (9.0:1).

tokens.name: band-2
tokens.usage: The top totals band, the filled part of a progress track and its legend swatch. Text: board (9.4:1). Every chart also gives its figures as a table (PRD §5.2).

tokens.name: band-pale
tokens.usage: A light legend swatch, with a band-2 border.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, and the dots of steps not reached yet.

tokens.name: map-dots
tokens.usage: The dotted ground of a map (1.1px dots every 18px), a map group's border, a link turned off.

tokens.name: map-edge
tokens.usage: Links on a map at 2px, dashed 6 6 when planned; the desk lines of the seating printout. 2.7:1 on sheet, under 3:1: a selected link turns board.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: The map's 10px attribution, on map-label-ground: 3.5:1, under the 4.5:1 text needs. Flagged.

tokens.name: map-label-ground
tokens.usage: Behind the map's attribution.

tokens.name: map-group
tokens.usage: The ground of a group of nodes on a map.

tokens.name: map-group-quiet
tokens.usage: The ground of a group on the operators' map.

tokens.name: node-gone
tokens.usage: A removed node or device on a map, dashed, with pencil text (5.0:1).

tokens.name: node-changed
tokens.usage: A node changed by a migration.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: The hovered column of a chart on the web.

tokens.name: hidden-hatch
tokens.usage: Hatching of a hidden row in a totals table.

tokens.name: idle-hatch
tokens.usage: Hatching of the days with no school in a timeline track.

tokens.name: pending-hatch
tokens.usage: With due, the hatching of a pending cell in an imported timetable.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only: the erase buttons, with on-subject text (8.6:1). Also marks below the pass mark in the lycée grade book, always with the figure itself.

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: An input error, such as a mark out of range, on paper (7.2:1) or sheet.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: A 'no' in a list of checks and the cross on a map link that is refused, on sheet (7.6:1).

tokens.name: tile-on
tokens.usage: A selected pupil tile during capture, with a board border. Text: ink.

tokens.name: en
tokens.usage: The English subject's colour: class chips and the book tab. Text on it: on-subject (6.9:1).

tokens.name: kept-ink
tokens.usage: The tick of what a release keeps (6.3:1 on sheet).

tokens.name: qr-ground
tokens.usage: The quiet zone around a QR code.

tokens.name: a4-line
tokens.usage: Text lines in an A4 thumbnail.

tokens.name: print-grid
tokens.usage: The rules of the month grid in a printout preview.

tokens.name: print-weekend
tokens.usage: Days with no school in the month grid preview.

tokens.name: print-before
tokens.usage: Days before a pupil arrived, in the month grid preview.

tokens.name: desk-edge
tokens.usage: A desk's outline in the seating printout.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Addition: the keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px gap, on every light ground (15:1 or more). The canvas defines none; the web app needs one (PRD §6.8).

tokens.name: focus-on-board
tokens.usage: Addition: the focus ring on board (12.8:1).

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The name on the welcome hero, in chalk on board.

styles.name: day
styles.usage: The page heading: the day on Today, the screen's subject on Classes and Marks.

styles.name: web-heading
styles.usage: The page heading on web screens.

styles.name: subject-tab
styles.usage: The vertical subject tab beside the book page, on the subject colour.

styles.name: book-head
styles.usage: Column headers of the book and homework pages, in head-ink.

styles.name: month-head
styles.usage: Column headers of the month page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Screen titles in Getting started and in the steps of a flow, such as the privacy screen.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: من المخطط السنوي إلى درس اليوم
styles.usage: The line under the name.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Bottom-sheet titles.

styles.name: bar-title
styles.usage: The title in the top bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: فهم المكتوب: يد واحدة لا تصفق
styles.usage: Arabic interface text, the base of every screen.

styles.name: card-text
styles.usage: A session's lesson in a card.

styles.name: class-chip
styles.usage: The class name on its subject colour.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons; the primary button is 16.5px.

styles.name: button-primary
styles.usage: The one primary button on a screen.

styles.name: fact
styles.sample: كل الحصص السابقة مؤكّدة · 3 حصص اليوم
styles.usage: The fact line under the day, in ink2.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chip labels.

styles.name: segment
styles.usage: Segmented control labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Second lines and hints, in ink2.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and section headers, in ink2.

styles.name: toggle
styles.usage: The roll-call toggles.

styles.name: bar-subtitle
styles.usage: The subtitle in the top bar, in ink2.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: The label of a proposal, in pencil.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: يمكن تصحيح أي حصة لاحقاً، ويُحفظ كل تعديل.
styles.usage: Reassurances and warnings beside an icon, in ink2.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Bottom-navigation labels; the current one is 700 in ink.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badges.

styles.name: body-latin
styles.usage: Interface text in French and English (left to right).

styles.name: stepper
styles.usage: The value of a stepper.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Figures in the roll-call stats.

styles.name: grid-figure
styles.usage: Counts in the absence grid.

styles.name: date
styles.usage: Dates on the book page, with tabular figures.

styles.name: roll-number
styles.usage: The number before each pupil, in ink2.

styles.name: grid-head
styles.usage: Day numbers in the absence grid header.

styles.name: page-number
styles.usage: The number in the page ring of the book.

styles.name: entry
styles.usage: An entry on the book page: one line every 28px, on the dotted ruling.

styles.name: entry-time
styles.usage: The time slot under the date of an entry.

styles.name: entry-latin
styles.usage: An entry when the subject is French.

styles.name: homework-small
styles.usage: The second line of a homework-page header.

styles.name: side-note
styles.sample: نشاطات التقويم المستمر: تشخيصي، تكويني، تحصيلي
styles.usage: The line above the homework page's headers, in ink2.

spacing.note: The steps the canvas uses. Its values are kept as drawn, not snapped to a grid.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a bar's title and subtitle; between a nav icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between the cells of the week grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: A bar's side padding; the snackbar's and due strip's inner padding; between setup steps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a label and its input; between an icon and its text in tags and warnings.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row, chips, stats and the parts of a meta line.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between the parts of a card; the book's padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between cards and at the list's sides; a card's padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: A card's padding at the sides; between the fields of a form.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The side padding of sheets, forms and the foot.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: The side padding of the page heading on phones, and of the main area on the web.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: The welcome hero's side padding.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: The 'due today' tag and the threshold chip.

tokens.name: radius-class
tokens.usage: The class chip; tooltips; map controls.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: Badges, the month page, map nodes, small key boxes.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, steppers, toggles, segmented controls, the book page, proposals, due strips, notices, key-and-value boxes, sidebar links.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, option rows, radio cards, row links, stats, the snackbar, the private panel, the signature pad, map frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The 56×30 pill behind the selected nav icon.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Session cards and large notices.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chips (half of 44px), and the top corners of a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-icon-button
tokens.usage: The round 48px icon button.

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: The bottom corners of the welcome hero.

tokens.name: radius-app-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon's tile at 512px (21.9% of its side).

tokens.name: shadow-focus-card
tokens.usage: The session card in focus on Today.

tokens.name: shadow-snack
tokens.usage: The snackbar.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A bottom sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: A chart's tooltip on the web.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: An A4 thumbnail.

tokens.name: shadow-node
tokens.usage: A node on a map.

tokens.name: shadow-controls
tokens.usage: A map's zoom controls.

tokens.name: shadow-note
tokens.usage: A note floating over a web table.

size.note: Sizes the canvas uses again and again.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: The smallest touch target: icon buttons, buttons, inputs, steppers, toggles, segments (PRD §6.8).

tokens.name: button-primary
tokens.usage: The height of the primary button.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The top bar.

tokens.name: nav
tokens.usage: The bottom navigation.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: Chips and check rows on the canvas: under the 48px target. Flagged under Accessibility.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icons: 24-unit grid, 1.8 stroke.

tokens.name: icon-small
tokens.usage: Small icons in facts, tags and strips.

tokens.name: book-line
tokens.usage: One line of the book page.

tokens.name: phone
tokens.usage: The phone width designed for: 360×800 (PRD §6.8).

tokens.name: web-sidebar
tokens.usage: The web sidebar's width.

tokens.name: web-detail
tokens.usage: The detail pane on web screens (300px on maps).
